method: Wikipedia borough pages and Commons file descriptions identify candidate artwork; Commons file licences and attribution apply to the particular illustration. Original search leads and earlier assessments are retained. Borough flags are out of scope and not published; flag research below is historical, not a selection of playable targets. Some flags are historically reported council-associated designs, not claims of formal current adoption. Unverified does not mean no symbol, and inclusion does not imply official permission.
